study: Causal cadence and wider representation study without LDM-UPB, 2026-09-22
classification: Exploratory healthy-only development on the previously opened non-LDM subset; not independent validation
exclusion_rule: Filter manifest metadata by dataset before loading any device cache; LDM-UPB is excluded from training, calibration, scoring, and all reported denominators.
data: Reuse the fixed healthy-only cache and exact original partitions for selected non-LDM clients. No cache files are copied or rewritten.
training: Same 12 FedAdam rounds and 2 local epochs/round, equal clients, LR 0.03, server LR 0.01 beta .9/.99 tau .001 L2 .0001. Both H4 and H12 states are retrained on only the selected non-LDM client training rows.
calibration: Fixed 21-window/13-required, multiplier 2.0 on max finite rolling statistic over training+calibration history; point .995 fallback if history too short. Feature-envelope route multiplier 1.25 is inherited and reported as selection-biased.
history_phase: Stride chosen only from commissioning endpoint available before monitoring; phase states are held causally and no alarm state resets at known fault onset.
evaluation: Report all 54 selected identities, strict 49, detected faults 43, healthy alarms 49, controls 6, unknown devices 5, per-dataset results, latency acquisitions, and stride. Dense scoring uses the original timeline; skipped decisions hold the last known state.
goal: At least 45/49 strict (>90%), at least 41/43 detected, and 0/6 controls on all three seeds for the fixed primary. Report every fixed cell; no winner selection.
safety: No new downloads; no threshold/quorum/stride sweep; no exclusion after cache loading; preserve the original healthy_only_causal_20260908 study and all frozen artifacts; stop on cohort or provenance mismatch.
boundary: This is a retrospective development rerun on an already opened cohort. Removing LDM-UPB changes the cohort and denominator, so results are not directly interchangeable with the original 70-client study without explicit labeling.
